observations: Two photos show the same stack of 20 books arranged in 4 rows of 5 on a tiled floor, photographed from above.

Visible titles include: How to Win Friends and Influence People (Dale Carnegie), Small Business Big Money, The Compound Effect (Darren Hardy), a 'Mountain Moving...' title, Zero to One (Peter Thiel style cover), The Millionaire Next Door, Everywoman, This Is Marketing (Seth Godin), How Successful People Think (John C. Maxwell), Women Rise Up! (Cindy Jacobs), What Every Woman Wants in a Man (Diana Hagee), Sell Like Crazy (Sabri Suby), The Seven Principles for Making Marriage Work (John Gottman), Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage, Words Matter, The Midas Touch, Spiritual Authority (Watchman Nee), an unclear gold-covered title, How Europe Underdeveloped Africa (Walter Rodney), The Psychology of Money (Morgan Housel).
A watermark 'EDENBOOKSTORE POSTED ON JIJI' appears on both images, indicating a reposted listing photo.
Covers appear intact and in reasonable visual condition from the top-down angle; no spine damage, water stains, or torn pages are visible, but only front covers are shown.
No price tags, receipts, or condition labels are visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Motivational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Titles visible in photo 0 and photo 1 (e.g. The Compound Effect, Seven Principles for Making Marriage Work, This Is Marketing, Psychology of Money) match these genres.

risks.risk: Actual physical condition (highlighting, torn pages, water damage, missing pages) cannot be judged from a top-down cover-only shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of spines, page edges, and a few opened interior pages per book or per stack.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, worst-case condition (heavy wear assumed)

risks.risk: Some titles could be photocopied/pirated editions rather than original publisher prints, common in this market segment.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the ISBN/barcode and publisher imprint page for each or a sample of the books.

risks.risk: Completeness of the set as advertised (seller may not include all 20 in final sale, or photo may be a stock/reused image).
risks.proof: A fresh photo with a handwritten date/name note next to the books, or a live video walkthrough.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming only the exact items shown are guaranteed

proof_requests: A video or photo showing the books fanned open to reveal page condition and any writing/highlighting.
Close-up of ISBN/barcode and publisher page for a sample of titles to confirm authenticity.
A current photo with today's date or seller's handwritten note to confirm these are the actual books being sold now.
response.reason: The books and their genres are clearly identifiable from the cover photos, so a worst-case used-condition price can be set even though interior condition and authenticity remain unverified.
